title: List out top 10 Spanish drivers who were born before 1982 and have the late
question:
List out top 10 Spanish drivers who were born before 1982 and have the latest lap time.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: born before 1982 refers to year(dob) < 1982; latest lap time refers to Max(time);

prediction.sql:
SELECT d.XCL_037, d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.XCL_034 = lt.XCL_044
WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'Spanish'
  AND strftime('%Y', d.XCL_040) < '1982'
ORDER BY lt.XCL_048 DESC
LIMIT 10
